The Tempest domain represents the power of storms and the sea. Its clerics are fierce warriors who call upon the fury of thunder and lightning to smite their enemies and protect the innocent.

Gods of the Tempest domain—including Talos, Umberlee, and Zeus—embrace the destructive power of nature and teach that only through conflict and struggle can strength be gained. They are often patrons of sailors and those who make their living on the sea.
2014_subclasses.tempest.bonus-proficienc: When you join the College of Lore at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.
Gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.
2014_subclasses.tempest.wrath-of-the-sto: Also at 1st level, you can use your reaction to deal lightning damage to a creature within 5 feet of you that you can see. When a creature within 5 feet of you that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to deal 2d8 lightning damage to the attacker. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
Also at 1st level, you can use your reaction to deal lightning damage to a creature within 5 feet of you that you can see. (reaction).
2014_subclasses.tempest.channel-divinity: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to maximize the damage of your lightning or thunder spells.
Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to maximize the damage of your lightning or thunder spells. (action).
2014_subclasses.tempest.thunderbolt-stri: Starting at 6th level, when you deal lightning damage to a creature, you can push it up to 10 feet away.
Starting at 6th level, when you deal lightning damage to a creature, you can push it up to 10 feet away.
2014_subclasses.tempest.potent-spellcast: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the damage rolls of your cleric spells.
Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the damage rolls of your cleric spells. (action).
2014_subclasses.tempest.stormborn.descri: Starting at 17th level, you gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage. Additionally, whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that deals lightning or thunder damage, you can fly up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
2014_subclasses.tempest.stormborn.summar: Additionally, whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that deals lightning or thunder damage, you can fly up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
2014_subclasses.trickery.description:
The Trickery domain represents the power of deception and illusion. Its clerics are cunning and resourceful, using their divine gifts to confuse and misdirect their enemies.

Gods of trickery—including Olidammara, the Traveler, and Loki—are patrons of thieves, scoundrels, and tricksters. They teach that one must be clever to survive in a world full of dangers and that sometimes the best way to defeat an enemy is through cunning rather than force.
2014_subclasses.trickery.blessing-of-the: At 1st level, you can use your action to touch a willing creature to give it advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
At 1st level, you can use your action to touch a willing creature to give it advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. (action).
2014_subclasses.trickery.channel-divinit: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to create an illusory duplicate of yourself. As an action, you create a perfect illusion of yourself that lasts for 1 minute, or until you lose concentration (as if you were concentrating on a spell). You can use your action to move the illusion up to 30 feet to a space you can see. The illusion is intangible and can't attack or take damage.
Can use your action to move the illusion up to 30 feet to a space you can see. (action).

At 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity to become invisible. As an action, you become invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you attack or force a creature to make a saving throw.
Become invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you attack or force a creature to make a saving throw. (action).
2014_subclasses.trickery.potent-spellcas: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the damage rolls of your cleric spells.
Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the damage rolls of your cleric spells. (action).
2014_subclasses.trickery.divine-strike.d: At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.
2014_subclasses.trickery.divine-strike.s: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage.
2014_subclasses.trickery.improved-duplic: At 17th level, you can create up to four illusory duplicates of yourself instead of one. You can use your action to move any number of them up to 30 feet, to spaces you can see.
Can use your action to move any number of them up to 30 feet, to spaces you can see. (action).
2014_subclasses.twilight.description: The twilight domain focuses on the transition between daylight and the dark of night, offering comfort and safety to those who must journey through darkness and rest in the shadows.
2014_subclasses.twilight.bonus-proficien: Gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.
You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.
2014_subclasses.twilight.eyes-of-night.s: Gain 300 feet of darkvision, and share it with willing creatures for 1 hour.
2014_subclasses.twilight.eyes-of-night.d: You can see through the deepest gloom. You have darkvision out to a range of 300 feet. In addition, as an action, you can magically share your darkvision with willing creatures you can see within 10 feet of you, up to a number equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one). The shared darkvision lasts for 1 hour, once per long rest, or by expending a spell slot of any level.
2014_subclasses.twilight.vigilant-blessi: Grant advantage on the next initiative roll to yourself or a touched creature.

The night has taught you to be watchful. As an action, you give one creature you touch (including possibly yourself) advantage on the next initiative roll the creature makes. This benefit ends immediately after the roll or if you use this feature again.
2014_subclasses.twilight.twilight-domain: Gain domain spells at levels 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9.

You gain domain spells at the cleric levels listed in the Twilight Domain Spells table: 1st: Faerie Fire, Sleep; 3rd: Moonbeam, See Invisibility; 5th: Aura of Vitality, Tiny Hut; 7th: Aura of Life, Greater Invisibility; 9th: Circle of Power, Mislead.
2014_subclasses.twilight.channel-divinit: Create a 30-foot sphere of twilight granting 1d6 + cleric level temp HP or ending charm/fear.

As an action, you present your holy symbol and utter a twilight prayer. A sphere of twilight emanates from you in a 30-foot radius. The sphere moves with you, is filled with dim light, and lasts for 1 minute or until you are incapacitated. Whenever a creature (including you) ends its turn in the sphere, you can grant that creature 1d6 + your cleric level temporary hit points, or end one effect on it causing it to be charmed or frightened.
Fly with flying speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute in dim light or darkness.

You draw on the mystical power of twilight to fly through the dark. As a bonus action when you are in dim light or darkness, you can magically give yourself a flying speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest.
2014_subclasses.twilight.divine-strike.s: Once on each of your turns, deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage on a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th).
2014_subclasses.twilight.divine-strike.d: At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.
2014_subclasses.twilight.twilight-shroud: Allies inside your Twilight Sanctuary gain the benefits of half cover (+2 AC and Dex saves).
The twilight that you summon offers a protective embrace: you and your allies have half cover while in the sphere created by your Twilight Sanctuary feature.
2014_subclasses.war.description:
The War domain represents the power of battle and conflict. Its clerics are divine warriors who inspire their allies and strike down their foes with righteous fury.

Gods of war—including Tempus, Nike, and Tyr—embrace the glory of combat and teach that conflict can be a noble pursuit when waged for a just cause. They inspire their followers to fight with honor and courage in the face of overwhelming odds.
When you join the College of Lore at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.
Gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.
2014_subclasses.war.war-priest.descripti: Also at 1st level, you can make a bonus action attack when you use the Attack action. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
2014_subclasses.war.war-priest.summary: Regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.war.channel-divinity-gui: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to add +10 to an attack roll.
Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to add +10 to an attack roll. (action).
2014_subclasses.war.channel-divinity-war: At 6th level, you can use your Channel Divinity to grant resistance to an ally. When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant that creature a +10 bonus to its attack roll.
Can use your reaction to grant that creature a +10 bonus to its attack roll. (reaction).
Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the damage rolls of your cleric spells.
Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the damage rolls of your cleric spells. (action).
2014_subclasses.war.avatar-of-battle.des: At 17th level, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.
2014_subclasses.war.avatar-of-battle.sum: At 17th level, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.
2014_subclasses.dreams.description: Druids who are members of the Circle of Dreams hail from regions that have strong ties to the Feywild and its dreamlike realms. The druids' guardianship of the natural world makes them natural allies of the fey.
2014_subclasses.dreams.balm-of-the-summe: At 2nd level, you become imbued with the blessings of the Summer Court. You gain a pool of fey energy represented by a number of d6s equal to your druid level. As a bonus action, you can choose one creature you can see within 120 feet of you and spend a number of those dice equal to half your druid level or less. Roll the spent dice and add them together. The target regains a number of hit points equal to the total. The target also gains 1 temporary hit point per die spent. You regain all expended dice when you finish a long rest.
Can choose one creature you can see within 120 feet of you and spend a number of those dice equal to half your druid level or less. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.dreams.hearth-of-moonlig: At 6th level, the magic of the Feywild guards your rest. When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes a saving throw or an attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant advantage to the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
Can use your reaction to grant advantage to the roll. (reaction).
2014_subclasses.dreams.hidden-paths.desc: Starting at 10th level, you can use the hidden paths that some fey use to traverse space in a blink of an eye. As a bonus action, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Alternatively, you can use your action to teleport one willing creature you touch up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
2014_subclasses.dreams.hidden-paths.summ: Can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. (bonus action).
At 14th level, the magic of the Feywild grants you the ability to travel mentally or physically through dreamlands. When you finish a short rest, you can cast the dream spell once without expending a spell slot. In addition, you can cast the following spells without expending a spell slot or material components: scrying (self only), teleportation circle. You can cast each of these spells once, and you regain the ability to cast them this way when you finish a long rest.
Can cast each of these spells once, and you regain the ability to cast them this way when you finish a long rest. (action).
2014_subclasses.circle-of-spores.descrip: Druids of the Circle of Spores find beauty in decay. They see within mold, fungi, and spores the ability to transform lifeless matter into abundant, albeit strange, life.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-spores.circle-: Learn Chill Touch and gain circle spells at levels 3, 5, 7, and 9.
You gain the Chill Touch cantrip. At 3rd level, Blindness/Deafness, Gentle Repose; 5th: Animate Dead, Gaseous Form; 7th: Blight, Confusion; 9th: Cloudkill, Contagion.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-spores.halo-of: Reaction deal 1d4 necrotic damage to a creature starting its turn or moving within 10 feet (scales to 1d8).

You are surrounded by invisible, necrotic spores. When a creature you can see starts its turn within 10 feet of you or moves there, you can use your reaction to deal 1d4 necrotic damage to that creature unless it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw. The damage increases to 1d6 at 6th, 1d8 at 10th, and 1d10 at 14th level.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-spores.symbiot: Expending Wild Shape grants 4 temp HP per druid level, doubles Halo of Spores damage, and adds 1d6 necrotic to melee hits.

As an action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape feature to awaken your spores. You gain 4 temporary hit points for each level you have in this class. While this feature is active, you roll your Halo of Spores damage die a second time, and your melee weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage on a hit.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-spores.fungal-: Animate a Small or Medium beast or humanoid that dies within 30 feet as a temporary zombie.

Your spores gain the ability to infest a corpse and animate it. When a beast or a humanoid that is Small or Medium dies within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to animate that creature with 1 hit point as a zombie under your command for 1 hour.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-spores.spreadi: Throw a 10-foot cube of spores up to 30 feet that damages creatures inside with Halo of Spores.

As a bonus action while your Symbiotic Entity feature is active, you can hurl spores up to 30 feet away, where they swirl in a 10-foot cube for 1 minute. Any creature that moves into the cube or starts its turn there takes your Halo of Spores damage.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-spores.fungal-: Gain immunity to being blinded, deafened, frightened, or poisoned, and critical hits against you become normal hits.
The fungal spores in your body alter you: you can't be blinded, deafened, frightened, or poisoned, and any critical hit against you counts as a normal hit instead, unless you're incapacitated.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-stars.descript: The Circle of Stars allows druids to draw on the power of starlight. These druids track constellations and map secret connections throughout the cosmos to unleash starry manifestations.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-stars.star-map: Create a star map focus, learn Guidance cantrip, and cast Guiding Bolt for free PB times per day.

You've created a star chart as part of your heavenly studies. You learn the Guidance cantrip. You also have the Guiding Bolt spell prepared, which counts as a druid spell for you and can be cast without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-stars.starry-f: Expending Wild Shape transforms you into a glimmering Starry Form: Archer, Chalice, or Dragon.

As a bonus action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape feature to take on a starry form for 10 minutes: Archer (bonus action ranged spell attack dealing 1d8 + Wis radiant damage), Chalice (healing a creature heals another creature for 1d8 + Wis), or Dragon (treat any roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10 for Concentration saves and Intelligence/Wisdom checks).
2014_subclasses.circle-of-stars.cosmic-o: Consult the stars after a rest to roll d6: add 1d6 to an ally's roll (Weal) or subtract 1d6 from an enemy's roll (Woe).

Whenever you finish a long rest, you can consult your Star Map for omens. Roll a d6: even is Weal (reaction add 1d6 to an ally's attack, save, or check within 30 ft), odd is Woe (reaction subtract 1d6 from a target's attack, save, or check within 30 ft). You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-stars.twinklin: The constellations of your Starry Form improve to 2d8, and you can switch forms each turn.

The constellations of your Starry Form become more potent: Archer and Chalice rolls increase to 2d8 radiant / healing, and Dragon form gives you a flying speed of 20 feet and hover. In addition, at the start of each of your turns while in Starry Form, you can switch which constellation is active.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-stars.full-of-: While in Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal with resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
While in your Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal, giving you resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-the-sea.descri: The Circle of the Sea is a druid circle that draws power from the ocean and its depths. These druids are at home in the water, and they command the tides and the creatures within them.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-the-sea.oceani: Starting at 2nd level, you can breathe air and water, and you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.
Starting at 2nd level, you can breathe air and water, and you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed. (permanent).
2014_subclasses.circle-of-the-sea.wrath-: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your action to magically summon a watery spray that lashes out at nearby creatures. Each creature within 30 feet of you that you can see must make a Dexterity saving throw against your druid spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.
On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. (instant, action).
2014_subclasses.circle-of-the-sea.elemen: At 6th level, you can expend two uses of Wild Shape instead of one to transform into a water elemental or a steamweird.
At 6th level, you can expend two uses of Wild Shape instead of one to transform into a water elemental or a steamweird. (action).
2014_subclasses.circle-of-the-sea.aquati: Starting at 10th level, you have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are underwater, and creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against you while you are underwater.
Starting at 10th level, you have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are underwater, and creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against you while you are underwater. (permanent).
2014_subclasses.circle-of-the-sea.oceani: Starting at 14th level, you can cast control water once per long rest without expending a spell slot. Additionally, you can breathe underwater indefinitely, and you have resistance to cold damage.
Additionally, you can breathe underwater indefinitely, and you have resistance to cold damage. (action).
2014_subclasses.shepherd.description: Druids of the Circle of the Shepherd commune with the spirits of nature, especially the spirits of beasts and the fey, and call to them for aid. These druids recognize that all living things play a role in the natural world.
2014_subclasses.shepherd.speech-of-the-w: At 2nd level, you gain the ability to converse with beasts and fey. You learn to speak, read, and write Sylvan. In addition, beasts can understand your speech, and you gain the ability to decipher their noises and motions. Most beasts lack the capacity for language, but a beast that knows a language can understand you.
At 2nd level, you gain the ability to converse with beasts and fey.
2014_subclasses.shepherd.spirit-totem.de:
Starting at 2nd level, you can call forth nature spirits to aid you and your allies. As a bonus action, you can use your Wild Shape to magically summon a nature spirit to a point you can see within 60 feet of you. The spirit is a spectral form of a bear, hawk, or unicorn, and it creates an aura in a 30-foot radius around it. The spirit is intangible and doesn't take up space. When you summon the spirit, choose which aura it creates:

Bear: The bear spirit grants you and your allies advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and you and your allies gain temporary hit points equal to your druid level.

Hawk: The hawk spirit grants you and your allies advantage on attack rolls against any creature in the aura, and you and your allies can use a reaction to make an opportunity attack against a creature that moves out of the aura.

Unicorn: The unicorn spirit grants you and your allies advantage on ability checks made to detect anything in the aura, and when you cast a healing spell with a spell slot, you and your allies regain hit points equal to your druid level.

The spirit remains for 1 minute, until you use this feature again, or until you die.
2014_subclasses.shepherd.spirit-totem.su: Can use your Wild Shape to magically summon a nature spirit to a point you can see within 60 feet of you. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.shepherd.mighty-summoner: Starting at 6th level, beasts and fey that you conjure are more resilient than normal. Any beast or fey that you summon or create with a spell gains the following benefits: The creature appears with more hit points than normal: 2 extra hit points per Hit Die it has. The weapon attacks of the creature count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.
The weapon attacks of the creature count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.
2014_subclasses.shepherd.guardian-spirit: Beginning at 10th level, when a beast or fey that you summoned or created with a spell ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura, it regains a number of hit points equal to half your druid level.
When a beast or fey that you summoned or created with a spell ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura, it regains a number of hit.
2014_subclasses.shepherd.faithful-summon: Starting at 14th level, the nature spirits you commune with protect you when you are the most vulnerable. When you are reduced to 0 hit points or are incapacitated against your will, you can use your reaction to conjure a nature spirit. The spirit appears within 60 feet of you and uses the spirit bear stat block, and it gains 40 temporary hit points. The spirit acts on its own initiative count. On each of its turns, it can take only the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to command the spirit, provided you are conscious. The spirit vanishes after 1 hour, when it is reduced to 0 hit points, when you use this feature again, or when you die.
The spirit appears within 60 feet of you and uses the spirit bear stat block, and it gains 40 temporary hit points. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.circle-of-wildfire.descr: Druids in the Circle of Wildfire understand that destruction is sometimes the precursor to creation, just as a forest fire promotes new growth.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-wildfire.circl: Gain wildfire spells at levels 2, 3, 5, 7, and 9.
2nd: Burning Hands, Cure Wounds; 3rd: Flaming Sphere, Scorching Ray; 5th: Plant Growth, Revivify; 7th: Aura of Life, Fire Shield; 9th: Flame Strike, Mass Cure Wounds.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-wildfire.summo: Expending a Wild Shape summons a friendly Wildfire Spirit that burns foes and obeys your commands.

You can summon the primal spirit bound to your soul. As an action, you can expend one use of your Wild Shape feature to summon your wildfire spirit within 30 feet. Each creature within 10 feet must succeed on a Dex save or take 2d6 fire damage. The spirit takes its turn immediately after yours, attacks with Flame Seed, and can teleport itself and willing allies with Fiery Teleportation.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-wildfire.enhan: Add 1d8 to rolls of spells that deal fire damage or restore hit points when your spirit is present.

The bond with your wildfire spirit enhances your destructive and restorative spells. Whenever you cast a spell that deals fire damage or restores hit points while your wildfire spirit is summoned, roll a 1d8 and add the number rolled to one damage or healing roll of the spell.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-wildfire.caute: Drop spectral flames when a creature dies within 30 feet to heal or damage a creature 2d10 + Wis.

You gain the ability to turn death into magical flames that can heal or incinerate. When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 feet of you or your wildfire spirit, a harmless spectral flame springs up in its space. When a creature touches it, you can use your reaction to either restore 2d10 + Wis HP to it or deal 2d10 + Wis fire damage.
2014_subclasses.circle-of-wildfire.blazi: When reduced to 0 HP, sacrifice your wildfire spirit to drop to 1 HP and regain half your max HP.

If you are reduced to 0 hit points and your wildfire spirit is within 120 feet of you, you can sacrifice the spirit to cause you to drop to 1 hit point instead of 0, and each creature within 10 feet of the sacrificed spirit takes fire damage equal to 2d10 + your Wisdom modifier.
2014_subclasses.land.description: The Circle of the Land is made up of mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites through a vast oral tradition. These druids meet within sacred circles of trees or standing stones to whisper primal secrets in Druidic. The circle's wisest members preside as the chief priests of communities that hold to the Old Faith and serve as advisors to the rulers of those folk. As a member of this circle, your magic is influenced by the land where you were initiated into the circle's mysterious rites.
2014_subclasses.land.bonus-cantrip.descr: When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.
2014_subclasses.land.bonus-cantrip.summa: Learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice. (action).
2014_subclasses.land.natural-recovery.de:
Starting at 2nd level, you can regain some of your magical energy by sitting in meditation and communing with nature. During a short rest, you choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.
For example, when you are a 4th-level druid, you can recover up to two levels worth of spell slots. You can recover either a 2nd-level slot or two 1st-level slots.
2014_subclasses.land.natural-recovery.su: Starting at 2nd level, you can regain some of your magical energy by sitting in meditation and communing with nature. (action).
2014_subclasses.land.circle-spells.descr:
Your mystical connection to the land infuses you with the ability to cast certain spells. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level you gain access to circle spells connected to the land where you became a druid.
Choose that land--arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, or swamp--and consult the associated list of spells.
Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.
2014_subclasses.land.circle-spells.terra: Choose your terrain type (arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, underdark)
2014_subclasses.land.circle-spells.summa: At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level you gain access to circle spells connected to the land where you became a druid. (action).
2014_subclasses.land.land-s-stride.descr:
Starting at 6th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such those created by the entangle spell.
2014_subclasses.land.land-s-stride.summa: In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such those created by the entangle spell.
2014_subclasses.land.nature-s-ward.descr: When you reach 10th level, you can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.
2014_subclasses.land.nature-s-ward.summa: Can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.
When you reach 14th level, creatures of the natural world sense your connection to nature and become hesitant to attack you. When a beast or plant creature attacks you, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your druid spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target, or the attack automatically misses. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours. The creature is aware of this effect before it makes its attack against you.
That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your druid spell save DC. (action).
2014_subclasses.moon.description:
Druids of the Circle of the Moon are fierce guardians of the natural order. They undergo special rituals that allow them to take on more powerful beast forms, transforming into creatures of great strength and ferocity.

These druids meet in secret places to share information and pass along warnings. They are masters of the wild, able to call upon the most powerful beasts to aid them in their sacred duty to protect nature from those who would do it harm.
2014_subclasses.moon.combat-wild-shape.d: At 2nd level, you can use Wild Shape as a bonus action.
2014_subclasses.moon.combat-wild-shape.s: At 2nd level, you can use Wild Shape as a bonus action. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.moon.circle-forms.descri: Also at 2nd level, you can transform into more powerful beasts.
2014_subclasses.moon.circle-forms.summar: Also at 2nd level, you can transform into more powerful beasts.
2014_subclasses.moon.primal-strike.descr: Starting at 6th level, your attacks in beast form count as magical.
2014_subclasses.moon.primal-strike.summa: Starting at 6th level, your attacks in beast form count as magical.
2014_subclasses.moon.elemental-wild-shap: At 10th level, you can expend two uses of Wild Shape to transform into an elemental.
At 10th level, you can expend two uses of Wild Shape to transform into an elemental. (action).
2014_subclasses.moon.thousand-forms.desc: At 14th level, you can cast the alter self spell at will.
2014_subclasses.moon.thousand-forms.summ: At 14th level, you can cast the alter self spell at will.
2014_subclasses.arcane-archer.descriptio: An Arcane Archer studies a unique elven method of archery that weaves magic into attacks to produce supernatural effects. Arcane Archers are some of the most elite warriors on the multiverse, serving as special forces for armies or as scouts for adventuring parties.
2014_subclasses.arcane-archer.arcane-arc: At 3rd level, you learn magical theory or some of the secrets of nature—typically related to the force of archery and the importance of focus. You learn either the prestidigitation or the druidcraft cantrip of your choice.
At 3rd level, you learn magical theory or some of the secrets of nature—typically related to the force of archery and the importance of focus.
2014_subclasses.arcane-archer.arcane-sho: At 3rd level, you learn to unleash special magical effects with some of your shots. When you gain this feature, you learn two Arcane Shot options of your choice. Once per turn when you fire a shortbow or longbow as part of the Attack action, you can apply one of your Arcane Shot options to the arrow. You decide to use the option after seeing the roll, but before the DM determines whether the attack hits or misses. You have two uses of this feature, and you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a short or long rest.
Learn two Arcane Shot options of your choice. (action).

The following options are available to you when you use your Arcane Shot feature:

Banishing Arrow: You banish the target you hit to a harmless demiplane until the end of your next turn. The target disappears, incapacitated. When the effect ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space.

Beguiling Arrow: Your charm inflicts psychic damage and causes the target to be charmed by you.

Bursting Arrow: The arrow creates a burst of energy that damages the target and up to two other creatures within 10 feet of it.

Enfeebling Arrow: The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks until the end of your next turn.

Grasping Arrow: Vines burst from the arrow, grasping the target and up to two other creatures within 10 feet of it.

Mind-Scrambling Arrow: The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target can't take reactions until the start of your next turn and must roll a d6 to determine its behavior.

Piercing Arrow: You make a ranged attack with the arrow as a normal ranged attack. The arrow passes through the target to another creature.

Seeking Arrow: You gain magical insight on the location of the target. You make a ranged attack with the arrow as a normal ranged attack. If the attack misses, you can use a bonus action to make a new attack against the same target.

Shadow Arrow: You weave illusion magic into your arrow, causing the target to be blinded until the end of your next turn.

2014_subclasses.arcane-archer.magic-arro: At 7th level, you gain the ability to infuse arrows with magic. Whenever you fire a nonmagical arrow from a shortbow or longbow, you can make it magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage. This magic fades from the arrow if it hasn't been used within 1 minute after you shoot it.
Whenever you fire a nonmagical arrow from a shortbow or longbow, you can make it magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage. (action).
2014_subclasses.arcane-archer.curving-sh: At 7th level, you learn to direct an errant arrow toward a new target. When you make an attack roll with a magic arrow and miss, you can use a bonus action to reroll the attack roll against a different target within 60 feet of the original target.
Can use a bonus action to reroll the attack roll against a different target within 60 feet of the original target. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.arcane-archer.ever-ready: Starting at 15th level, your magical archery is always at the ready. You regain all expended uses of your Arcane Shot feature when you finish a short or long rest.
Regain all expended uses of your Arcane Shot feature when you finish a short or long rest. (action).
2014_subclasses.battle-master.descriptio:
The Battle Master is a supreme warrior who uses a variety of maneuvers to control the battlefield. Drawing on extensive combat experience and tactical knowledge, the Battle Master can turn the tide of battle with well-timed strikes and clever stratagems. Those who emulate this martial archetype combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows.

Battle Masters study the art of war, learning to read their opponents and exploit their weaknesses with precision and cunning. They use superiority dice to fuel powerful maneuvers that can disarm, trip, or push their enemies, turning the tide of battle in their favor.
2014_subclasses.battle-master.combat-sup: You learn maneuvers fueled by superiority dice (d8s). You gain 4 superiority dice at level 3, regaining them on a short or long rest. You learn 3 maneuvers at level 3, and additional maneuvers at higher levels.
Choose three maneuvers from the Battle Master list.
Use bonus action to direct an ally to attack — they add your superiority die to their damage
Add superiority die to damage — target makes STR save or drops one held item
Add superiority die to damage — next attack against target before your next turn has advantage
Add superiority die to AC until end of your move
Use bonus action to feint — gain advantage on next attack and add superiority die to damage
Add superiority die to damage — target makes WIS save or has disadvantage attacking anyone but you
Increase melee attack reach by 5ft and add superiority die to damage
Add superiority die to damage — ally can move half speed without provoking opportunity attacks
Add superiority die to damage — target makes WIS save or becomes frightened until end of next turn
Use reaction when hit — reduce damage by superiority die plus DEX modifier
Add superiority die to an attack roll before knowing if it hits
Add superiority die to damage — target makes STR save or is pushed up to 15ft away
Use bonus action to give an ally temporary HP equal to superiority die plus CHA modifier
Use reaction when a creature misses you — make one melee attack and add superiority die to damage
Deal superiority die damage to a second creature adjacent to the first target
Add superiority die to damage — target makes STR save or is knocked prone if Large or smaller
Spend superiority dice to fuel powerful combat maneuvers.

2014_subclasses.battle-master.know-your-: Starting at 7th level, if you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own. The DM tells you if the creature is your equal, superior, or inferior in regard to two of the following characteristics of your choice: Strength score, Dexterity score, Constitution score, Armor Class, Current hit points, Total class levels, Fighter class levels.
The DM tells you if the creature is your equal, superior, or inferior in regard to two of the following characteristics of your choice: Strength score, Dexterity score, Constitution (action).
2014_subclasses.battle-master.improved-c: At 10th level, your superiority dice turn into d10s.
At 10th level, your superiority dice turn into d10s.
2014_subclasses.battle-master.relentless: Starting at 15th level, when you roll initiative and have no superiority dice remaining, you regain 1 superiority die.

2014_subclasses.battle-master.improved-c: At 18th level, your superiority dice turn into d12s.

2014_subclasses.cavalier.description: The Cavalier is a mounted warrior who serves as a champion for a noble cause. Cavaliers are skilled in combat, both mounted and on foot, and they are known for their unwavering dedication to their oath.
2014_subclasses.cavalier.bonus-proficien: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice.
Gain proficiency in Animal Handling skill.
Learn one language of your choice.
Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice. (action).
2014_subclasses.cavalier.born-to-the-sad: Starting at 3rd level, you have advantage on saving throws made to avoid falling off your mount. If you fall off your mount and land within 5 feet of it, you take no damage. Finally, mounting or dismounting a creature costs you only 5 feet of movement, rather than half your speed.
Finally, mounting or dismounting a creature costs you only 5 feet of movement, rather than half your speed.
2014_subclasses.cavalier.unwavering-mark: Starting at 3rd level, you can menace your foes, foiling their attacks and punishing them for harming others. When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can mark the creature until the end of your next turn. This effect ends early if you are incapacitated or die, or if someone else marks the target. While it is within 5 feet of you, a marked creature has disadvantage on any attack roll that doesn't target you. In addition, if a marked creature deals damage to anyone other than you, you can make a special melee attack against the marked creature as a bonus action on your next turn. You have advantage on the attack roll, and if it hits, your weapon deals extra damage equal to half your fighter level. Regardless of whether you use this bonus action, you can use it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
A marked creature has disadvantage on any attack roll that doesn't target you. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.cavalier.warding-maneuve: At 7th level, you learn to fend off strikes directed at you, your mount, or other creatures nearby. If you or a creature you can see within 5 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to roll 1d8 and reduce the damage by that amount + your proficiency bonus. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
Can use your reaction to roll 1d8 and reduce the damage by that amount + your proficiency bonus. (reaction).
2014_subclasses.cavalier.hold-the-line.d: Starting at 10th level, you become a master of locking down your enemies. Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you when they move 5 feet or more while within your reach. In addition, if a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against a target other than you, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against the attacking creature.
2014_subclasses.cavalier.hold-the-line.s: Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you when they move 5 feet or more while within your reach. (reaction).
2014_subclasses.cavalier.ferocious-charg: Starting at 15th level, you can run down your foes, whether you're mounted or not. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line right before attacking a creature and you hit it with a melee weapon attack, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be knocked prone. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or be knocked prone. (action).
2014_subclasses.cavalier.vigilant-defend: Starting at 18th level, you respond to danger with extraordinary vigilance. In combat, you gain a special reaction that you can take once on every creature's turn, except your turn. You can't use this reaction on the same turn that you take your normal reaction.
In combat, you gain a special reaction that you can take once on every creature's turn, except your turn. (reaction).
2014_subclasses.champion.description: The archetypal Champion focuses on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. Those who model themselves on this archetype combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows.
2014_subclasses.champion.improved-critic: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. (action).
2014_subclasses.champion.remarkable-athl: Starting at 7th level, you can add half your proficiency bonus (round up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus. In addition, when you make a running long jump, the distance you can cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.
Starting at 7th level, you can add half your proficiency bonus (round up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus. (action).
2014_subclasses.champion.additional-figh: At 10th level, you can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.
At 10th level, you can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature. (action).
2014_subclasses.champion.superior-critic: Starting at 15th level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.
Starting at 15th level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20. (action).
2014_subclasses.champion.survivor.descri: At 18th level, you attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle. At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points.
2014_subclasses.champion.survivor.summar: At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points.
2014_subclasses.echo-knight.description: A mysterious warrior who can summon an echo of themselves from unspent potential, the Echo Knight uses their own shadow as a weapon. These fighters are rare and often misunderstood, for they walk the line between what is and what could be.
2014_subclasses.echo-knight.manifest-ech: You can use a bonus action to magically manifest a translucent, gray image of yourself in an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of you. This echo lasts until it is destroyed, you dismiss it, you manifest another echo, or you're incapacitated. Your echo has AC 14 + your proficiency bonus, 1 hit point, and immunity to all conditions. If it has to make a saving throw, use your save bonus. It is the same size as you, and it occupies its space. On your turn, you can mentally command the echo to move up to 30 feet in any direction (no action required). You can use it as the origin for your attacks and you can make opportunity attacks as if you were in its space.
Can use a bonus action to magically manifest a translucent, gray image of yourself in an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of you. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.echo-knight.unleash-inca: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one additional melee attack from the echo's space. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
Regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. (action).
As a bonus action, you can teleport, magically swapping places with your echo at a cost of 15 feet of your movement, regardless of the distance between the two of you. Immediately before you teleport, you can see through its eyes and hear through its ears until the start of your next turn, gaining the benefits of any special senses that the echo has. During this time, you are deaf and blind with regard to your own senses.
Can teleport, magically swapping places with your echo at a cost of 15 feet of your movement, regardless of the distance between the two of you. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.echo-knight.shadow-marty: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of your echo, you can use your reaction to teleport, causing the echo to teleport to the space you were in and become the target of the attack instead. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
Can use your reaction to teleport, causing the echo to teleport to the space you were in and become the target of the attack instead. (reaction).
2014_subclasses.echo-knight.reclaim-pote: When your echo is destroyed by taking damage, you can use your reaction to gain a number of temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + your Constitution modifier. If you end your turn with these temporary hit points, you lose them. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
Can use your reaction to gain a number of temporary hit points equal to 2d6 + your Constitution modifier. (reaction).
2014_subclasses.echo-knight.legion-of-on: When you use Manifest Echo, you can create two echoes with it, and these echoes can coexist. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one additional melee attack from the space of each echo. Moreover, when you use Unleash Incarnation, you can make the additional attack from either echo's space.
Can create two echoes with it, and these echoes can coexist. (action).
2014_subclasses.eldritch-knight.descript:
The Eldritch Knight combines the martial prowess of a fighter with the arcane power of a wizard. Through years of study and practice, these warriors learn to cast spells while wearing armor and wielding heavy weapons.

Eldritch Knights are versatile combatants, able to adapt to any situation by combining sword and sorcery. They are often found on the front lines, using their magical abilities to protect their allies and smite their enemies.
2014_subclasses.eldritch-knight.spellcas: When you reach 3rd level, you augment your martial prowess with the ability to cast spells. Cantrips. You learn two cantrips of your choice from the wizard spell list. You learn an additional wizard cantrip of your choice at 10th level. Spell Slots. The Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your wizard spells of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these spells, you must expend a slot of the spell's level or higher. You regain all expended spell slots when you finish a long rest. Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher. You know three 1st-level wizard spells of your choice, two of which you must choose from the abjuration and evocation spells on the wizard spell list. The Spells Known column of the Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table shows when you learn more wizard spells of 1st level or higher. Each of these spells must be an abjuration or evocation spell of your choice, and must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For instance, when you reach 7th level in this class, you can learn one new spell of 1st or 2nd level. The spells you learn at 8th, 14th, and 20th level can come from any school of magic. Spellcasting Ability. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your wizard spells, since you learn your spells through study and memorization. You use your Intelligence whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a wizard spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one. Spell save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier Spell attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier
In addition, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a wizard spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.
2014_subclasses.eldritch-knight.weapon-b: At 3rd level, you learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. You perform the ritual over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a short rest. The weapon must be within your reach throughout the ritual, at the conclusion of which you touch the weapon and forge the bond. Once you have bonded a weapon to yourself, you can't be disarmed of that weapon unless you are incapacitated. If it is on the same plane of existence, you can summon that weapon as a bonus action on your turn, causing it to teleport instantly to your hand. You can have up to two bonded weapons, but can summon only one at a time with your bonus action. If you attempt to bond with a third weapon, you must break the bond with one of the other two.
At 3rd level, you learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.eldritch-knight.war-magi: Beginning at 7th level, when you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
Beginning at 7th level, when you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.eldritch-knight.eldritch: At 10th level, you learn how to make your weapon strikes undercut a creature's resistance to your spells. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.
At 10th level, you learn how to make your weapon strikes undercut a creature's resistance to your spells.
2014_subclasses.eldritch-knight.arcane-c: At 15th level, you gain the ability to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see when you use your Action Surge. You can teleport before or after the additional action.
At 15th level, you gain the ability to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see when you use your Action Surge. (action).
2014_subclasses.eldritch-knight.improved: Starting at 18th level, when you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.
Starting at 18th level, when you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.psi-warrior.description: Psi Warriors augment their martial might with psionic energy, using mental disciplines to shield allies, propel weapons, and leap through the air.
2014_subclasses.psi-warrior.psionic-powe: Harbor Psionic Energy dice (d6s scaling to d12s) to fuel Protective Field, Psionic Strike, and Telekinetic Movement.

You harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within yourself. You have a number of Psionic Energy dice equal to twice your proficiency bonus, which are d6s (scaling to d8 at 5th, d10 at 11th, and d12 at 17th level). You can use your dice for: Protective Field (reaction reduce damage to yourself or an ally within 30 ft by die roll + Int mod), Psionic Strike (deal extra force damage equal to die roll + Int mod on a weapon hit), or Telekinetic Movement (move an object or willing creature up to 30 ft as an action).
2014_subclasses.psi-warrior.telekinetic-: Gain flying speed equal to twice your walking speed until the end of your current turn.

As a bonus action, you can propel your body with your mind. You gain a flying speed equal to twice your walking speed until the end of the current turn. Once you take this bonus action, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy die to take it again.
2014_subclasses.psi-warrior.guarded-mind: Gain resistance to psychic damage, and expend a Psionic Energy die to end charmed or frightened.

The psionic energy flowing through you has bolstered your mind. You have resistance to psychic damage. Moreover, if you start your turn charmed or frightened, you can expend one Psionic Energy die and immediately end every effect on yourself subjecting you to those conditions.
2014_subclasses.psi-warrior.bulwark-of-f: Shield yourself and allies within 30 feet with half cover (+2 AC and Dex saves) for 1 minute.

As a bonus action, you can shield yourself and others with telekinetic force. You choose a number of creatures within 30 feet of you equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one), including yourself. For 1 minute or until you are incapacitated, the chosen creatures have half cover. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy die.
2014_subclasses.psi-warrior.telekinetic-: Cast Telekinesis without components, and make a weapon attack as a bonus action while concentrating on it.

Your ability to move creatures and objects with your mind is unmatched. You can cast the Telekinesis spell without components, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability. On each turn while you concentrate on the spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. Once you cast Telekinesis with this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy die.
2014_subclasses.rune-knight.description: Rune Knights discover how to enhance their martial prowess using the runic magic of giants, etching supernatural runes into their arms and armor.
2014_subclasses.rune-knight.bonus-profic: Gain proficiency with smith's tools and learn to speak, read, and write Giant.
You gain proficiency with smith's tools, and you learn to speak, read, and write Giant.
Inscribe giant runes on equipment to gain passive benefits and activated magical invocations.

You can use magic runes to enhance your gear. You learn two runes of your choice (Cloud, Fire, Frost, Stone, Hill, or Storm). Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch a number of objects equal to the number of runes you know and inscribe a different rune onto each. Each rune grants a passive bonus and can be invoked once per short or long rest for a powerful magical effect.
2014_subclasses.rune-knight.giant-s-migh: Grow to Large size, gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, and deal +1d6 damage once per turn.

As a bonus action, you magically imbue yourself with the might of giants. For 1 minute: if you are smaller than Large, you become Large along with anything you are wearing; you have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws; and once on each of your turns, one of your weapon attacks or unarmed strikes can deal an extra 1d6 damage to a target on a hit. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
2014_subclasses.rune-knight.runic-shield: Force an attacker within 60 feet who hits an ally to reroll the d20 and take the new roll.

You learn to invoke your runic magic to protect your allies. When another creature you can see within 60 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to reroll the d20 and use the new roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
2014_subclasses.rune-knight.great-statur: Your height increases by 3d4 inches, and your Giant's Might damage increases to 1d8.

The magic of your runes permanently alters you. When you gain this feature, roll 3d4; you grow a number of inches in height equal to the roll. Moreover, the extra damage you deal with your Giant's Might feature increases to 1d8.
2014_subclasses.rune-knight.master-of-ru: Invoke each rune you have inscribed twice per short or long rest instead of once.
You can invoke each such rune twice, rather than once, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.
2014_subclasses.rune-knight.runic-jugger: Giant's Might allows you to grow to Huge size, reach increases by 5 feet, and extra damage becomes 1d10.

You learn how to amplify your rune-powered transformation. As a result, the extra damage you deal with the Giant's Might feature increases to 1d10. Moreover, when you use that feature, your size can increase to Huge, and while you are that size, your reach increases by 5 feet.
2014_subclasses.samurai.description: The Samurai is a fighter who draws on an implacable fighting spirit to overcome enemies. A Samurai's resolve is nearly unbreakable, and the Samurai's fighting spirit grants strength and speed.
2014_subclasses.samurai.bonus-proficienc: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with one of the following skills of your choice: History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice.
Learn one language of your choice.
Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice. (action).
Starting at 3rd level, your intensity in battle can shield you and help you strike true. As a bonus action on your turn, you can give yourself advantage on weapon attack rolls until the end of your current turn, gaining 5 temporary hit points. The number of temporary hit points increases to 10 at 10th level and to 15 at 15th level. You can use this feature three times, and you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.
Can give yourself advantage on weapon attack rolls until the end of your current turn, gaining 5 temporary hit points. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.samurai.elegant-courtier: Starting at 7th level, your discipline and attention to detail allow you to excel in social situations. Whenever you make a Wisdom (Insight) check, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10. In addition, you gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have proficiency in Wisdom saving throws, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).
In addition, you gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. (action).
Starting at 10th level, when you roll initiative and have no uses of Fighting Spirit remaining, you regain one use.
Starting at 10th level, when you roll initiative and have no uses of Fighting Spirit remaining, you regain one use. (action).
2014_subclasses.samurai.rapid-strike.des: Starting at 15th level, you can sacrifice accuracy to make additional strikes. If you take the Attack action on your turn, you can forgo advantage on one of the attacks to make an additional weapon attack as a bonus action.
2014_subclasses.samurai.rapid-strike.sum: Can forgo advantage on one of the attacks to make an additional weapon attack as a bonus action. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.samurai.strength-before-: Starting at 18th level, your fighting spirit can delay the grasp of death. If you take damage that reduces you to 0 hit points and doesn't kill you outright, you can use your reaction to delay falling unconscious, and you can immediately take an extra turn, interrupting the current turn. While you have 0 hit points during that extra turn, taking damage causes a death saving throw failure, and three failures can kill you. When the extra turn ends, you fall unconscious if you still have 0 hit points. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
Taking damage causes a death saving throw failure, and three failures can kill you. (reaction).
2014_subclasses.ascendant-dragon.descrip: Monks of the Ascendant Dragon tradition learn to channel the elemental power of dragons through their ki. These monks can harness the destructive energy of dragonkind, unleashing it through their unarmed strikes and breath weapons.
2014_subclasses.ascendant-dragon.draconi: You gain the following benefits: You learn the draconic language. You learn one cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer spell list. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.
Learn one cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer spell list.
2014_subclasses.ascendant-dragon.breath-: You can channel draconic power into a destructive breath. As an action, you can spend 1 ki point to exhale a 15-foot cone of elemental energy. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier). On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 damage of a type you choose: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. The damage increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th level, and 5d6 at 16th level.
On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 damage of a type you choose: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. (action).
2014_subclasses.ascendant-dragon.wings-u: When you use your Step of the Wind, you can unfurl spectral draconic wings, granting you a flying speed equal to your walking speed until the end of your turn.
Can unfurl spectral draconic wings, granting you a flying speed equal to your walking speed until the end of your turn. (action).
2014_subclasses.ascendant-dragon.aspect-: You can channel the might of dragonkind to gain draconic traits. As a bonus action, you can spend 3 ki points to manifest these traits for 1 minute. For the duration, you have resistance to the damage type associated with your Breath of the Dragon, and your Breath of the Dragon deals an additional 2d6 damage.
Have resistance to the damage type associated with your Breath of the Dragon, and your Breath of the Dragon deals an additional 2d6 damage. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.ascendant-dragon.ascenda: You gain the following benefits: You can use your Breath of the Dragon without spending ki points. When you use your Breath of the Dragon, you can choose to increase its area to a 30-foot cone.
Can choose to increase its area to a 30-foot cone. (action).
2014_subclasses.open-hand.description: Monks of the Way of the Open Hand are the ultimate masters of martial arts combat, whether armed or unarmed. They learn techniques to push and trip their opponents, manipulate ki to heal damage to their bodies, and practice advanced meditation that can protect them from harm.
2014_subclasses.open-hand.open-hand-tech:
Starting when you choose this tradition at 3rd level, you can manipulate your enemy's ki when you harness your own. Whenever you hit a creature with one of the attacks granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of the following effects on that target:
- It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
- It must make a Strength saving throw. If it fails, you can push it up to 15 feet away from you.
- It can't take reactions until the end of your next turn.

When you hit a creature with an attack from Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of three effects: the target must make a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone, pushed away, or unable to take Reactions until the end of your next turn.
2014_subclasses.open-hand.wholeness-of-b: At 6th level, you gain the ability to heal yourself. As an action, you can regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. You must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.
Can regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. (action).
2014_subclasses.open-hand.tranquility.de: Beginning at 11th level, you can enter a special meditation that surrounds you with an aura of peace. At the end of a long rest, you gain the effect of a sanctuary spell that lasts until the start of your next long rest (the spell can end early as normal). The saving throw DC for the spell equals 8 + your Wisdom modifier + your proficiency bonus.
2014_subclasses.open-hand.tranquility.su: The saving throw DC for the spell equals 8 + your Wisdom modifier + your proficiency bonus.
2014_subclasses.open-hand.quivering-palm:
At 17th level, you gain the ability to set up lethal vibrations in someone's body. When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 ki points to start these imperceptible vibrations, which last for a number of days equal to your monk level. The vibrations are harmless unless you use your action to end them. To do so, you and the target must be on the same plane of existence. When you use this action, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, it is reduced to 0 hit points. If it succeeds, it takes 10d10 necrotic damage.
You can have only one creature under the effect of this feature at a time. You can choose to end the vibrations harmlessly without using an action.

When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, spend 3 ki points to start vibrations that last for days equal to your monk level. You can end them early as an action to deal 10d10 necrotic damage; the target must make a Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 Hit Points.
2014_subclasses.shadow.description:
Monks of the Way of Shadow follow the path of darkness and stealth. They learn to use ki to manipulate shadows, becoming invisible and striking from the darkness with deadly precision.

These monks are spies, assassins, and infiltrators, using their abilities to move unseen and gather information. They are masters of the night, able to blend into the shadows and disappear at will.
2014_subclasses.shadow.shadow-arts.descr: At 3rd level, you can use ki to replicate certain spells. As an action, you can spend 2 ki points to cast the darkness, darkvision, pass without trace, or silence spells, without providing material components. Additionally, you gain the minor illusion cantrip if you don't already know it.
2014_subclasses.shadow.shadow-arts.summa: Additionally, you gain the minor illusion cantrip if you don't already know it. (action).
2014_subclasses.shadow.shadow-step.descr: At 6th level, you gain the ability to step from one shadow into another. When you are in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness. You then have advantage on the first melee attack you make before the end of the turn.
2014_subclasses.shadow.shadow-step.summa: As a bonus action you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness. (bonus action).
By 11th level, you have learned to become one with the shadows. When you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you can use your action to become invisible. You remain invisible until you make an attack, cast a spell, or are in an area of bright light.
Remain invisible until you make an attack, cast a spell, or are in an area of bright light. (action).
2014_subclasses.shadow.opportunist.descr: At 17th level, you can exploit a creature's momentary distraction when it is hit by an attack. When a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack from an attacker other than you, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against that creature.
2014_subclasses.shadow.opportunist.summa: Can use your reaction to make a melee attack against that creature. (reaction).
2014_subclasses.way-of-mercy.description: Monks of the Way of Mercy learn to manipulate the life force of others to bring aid to those in need. They are wandering physicians and harbingers of swift death to those beyond saving.
2014_subclasses.way-of-mercy.implements-: Gain proficiency in Insight, Medicine, and the herbalism kit, and craft a unique mercy mask.
You gain proficiency in the Insight and Medicine skills, and you gain proficiency with the herbalism kit. You also gain a special mask, which you often wear when conducting your work.
2014_subclasses.way-of-mercy.hands-of-he: Spend 1 ki to touch a creature and heal hit points equal to your Martial Arts die + Wis modifier.

Your mystical touch can mend wounds. As an action, you can spend 1 ki point to touch a creature and restore a number of hit points equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier. When you use your Flurry of Blows, you can replace one of the unarmed strikes with a use of this feature without spending its ki point.
2014_subclasses.way-of-mercy.hands-of-ha: Spend 1 ki when hitting with an unarmed strike to deal extra necrotic damage equal to Martial Arts die + Wis.

You can use your ki to inflict wounds. When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 ki point to deal extra necrotic damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier. You can use this feature only once per turn.
2014_subclasses.way-of-mercy.physician-s: Hands of Healing cures disease, blindness, paralysis, or poisoned; Hands of Harm poisons the target without a save.

Starting at 6th level, you can administer even greater medical aid with your touch. When you use Hands of Healing, you can also end one disease or one condition afflicting the target: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned. When you use Hands of Harm on a creature, you can subject that creature to the poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.
2014_subclasses.way-of-mercy.flurry-of-h: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace both attacks with Hands of Healing without spending extra ki.

Starting at 11th level, you can now use Hands of Healing to heal a creature with both of the unarmed strikes granted by your Flurry of Blows, without spending extra ki points. In addition, when you make an unarmed strike with Flurry of Blows, you can use Hands of Harm with that strike without spending the ki point for Hands of Harm.
2014_subclasses.way-of-mercy.hand-of-ult: Touch a creature that died within 24 hours and spend 5 ki points to return it to life with 4d10 + Wis HP.

Your mastery of life energy opens the door to the ultimate mercy. As an action, you can touch the corpse of a creature that died within the past 24 hours and expend 5 ki points. The creature returns to life, regaining a number of hit points equal to 4d10 + your Wisdom modifier. If the creature died while subject to any of the following conditions, it revives with those conditions removed: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
2014_subclasses.way-of-the-astral-self.d: A monk who follows the Way of the Astral Self believes their body is an illusion. They see their ki as a representation of their true form: the astral self.
2014_subclasses.way-of-the-astral-self.a: Spend 1 ki to summon spectral astral arms dealing force damage with Wisdom for attacks/checks.

Your ki allows you to manifest spectral arms. As a bonus action, you can spend 1 ki point to summon the arms of your astral self for 10 minutes. Each creature within 10 feet must succeed on a Dex save or take 2x your Martial Arts die in force damage. While active, you can use Wisdom modifier in place of Strength for checks and saves, your unarmed strike reach increases by 5 feet, and your unarmed strikes deal force damage using Wisdom.
2014_subclasses.way-of-the-astral-self.v: Spend 1 ki to manifest an astral mask gaining darkvision through magical darkness, Insight/Intimidation advantage, and whisper projection.

You can summon the spectral visage of your astral self. As a bonus action, or as part of summoning your arms, you spend 1 ki point to manifest your visage for 10 minutes. You gain Astral Sight (see in normal and magical darkness out to 120 ft), Wisdom of the Spirit (advantage on Insight and Intimidation checks), and Word of the Astral Self (project your voice to whisper up to 600 ft or boom 3x loud).
2014_subclasses.way-of-the-astral-self.b: Manifest astral armor: deflect elemental damage as a reaction, and make 3 attacks with Flurry of Blows.

When you have both your astral arms and visage active, you can manifest the complete body of your astral self. You gain: Deflect Energy (reaction reduce acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder damage by 1d10 + Wis mod) and Empowered Arms (once on each of your turns when you hit with your astral arms, deal extra damage equal to your Martial Arts die).
2014_subclasses.way-of-the-astral-self.a: Spend 5 ki to summon your full astral form: +2 AC, 3 attacks per Extra Attack, and crushing force.

You can awaken the full power of your astral self. As a bonus action, you can spend 5 ki points to summon your arms, visage, and body simultaneously for 10 minutes. While active: you gain a +2 bonus to AC, you can make three attacks instead of two whenever you take the Attack action with your astral arms, and when you hit a target you can deal extra force damage.
2014_subclasses.drunken-master.descripti: The Way of the Drunken Master teaches its students to move with the jerky, unpredictable movements of a drunkard. A drunken master sways, tottering on unsteady feet, to present what seems like an incompetent combatant who proves frustrating to engage. The drunken master's erratic stumbles conceal a carefully executed dance of blocks, parries, advances, and attacks.
2014_subclasses.drunken-master.bonus-pro: At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in the Performance skill if you don't already have it. Your unarmored movement speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield, and you gain proficiency with brewer's supplies if you don't already have it.
Your unarmored movement speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield, and you gain proficiency with brewer's supplies if you don't already have.
2014_subclasses.drunken-master.drunken-t: At 3rd level, you learn how to twist away from danger. When you use your Flurry of Blows, you can disengage as a bonus action, and your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.
Can disengage as a bonus action, and your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the current turn. (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.drunken-master.tipsy-swa: Starting at 6th level, you can dodge in unanticipated ways, seemingly moving out of harm's way at the last moment. When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to spend 1 ki point to make a melee attack against the creature. If the attack hits, the creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
The creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. (reaction).
2014_subclasses.drunken-master.drunkard-: Starting at 11th level, you always seem to get a lucky bounce at the right moment. When you make an ability check, an attack roll, or a saving throw that has disadvantage, you can spend 2 ki points to cancel the disadvantage for that roll.
An attack roll, or a saving throw that has disadvantage, you can spend 2 ki points to cancel the disadvantage for that roll. (action).
2014_subclasses.drunken-master.intoxicat: At 17th level, you gain the ability to make a whirlwind of attacks. When you use your Flurry of Blows, you can make up to three additional attacks with it (up to a total of five attacks), provided that each attack targets a different creature.
At 17th level, you gain the ability to make a whirlwind of attacks. (action).
2014_subclasses.four-elements.descriptio: You follow a monastic tradition that teaches you to harness the elements. When you focus your ki, you can align yourself with the forces of creation and bend the four elements to your will.
2014_subclasses.four-elements.disciple-o: Learn magical disciplines that harness earth, air, fire, and water by spending ki points.

You learn magical disciplines that harness the power of the four elements. A discipline requires you to spend ki points each time you use it. You know the Elemental Attunement discipline and one other elemental discipline of your choice. You learn one additional elemental discipline of your choice at 6th, 11th, and 17th level.
2014_subclasses.four-elements.elemental-: Produce minor harmless elemental effects, create sparks, cool or warm objects, or shape mist.
