2014_subclasses.graviturgy.violent-attra: Starting at 10th level, you can use your command of gravity to increase the force of your attacks. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can use a bonus action to choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. That creature takes force damage equal to your Intelligence modifier, and you can move it 10 feet toward you or away from you (your choice). You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
That creature takes force damage equal to your Intelligence modifier, and you can move it 10 feet toward you or away from you (your choice). (bonus action).
2014_subclasses.graviturgy.gravity-sinkh: At 14th level, you can create a devastating gravitational anomaly. As an action, you can choose a point you can see within 120 feet of you. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5d10 force damage and is restrained until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't restrained. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
On a failed save, a creature takes 5d10 force damage and is restrained until the start of your next turn. (action).
2014_subclasses.illusion.description:
Illusionists create false images and manipulate perceptions. They can make things appear or disappear, create phantasmal creatures, and alter the appearance of themselves and others.

The study of illusion requires creativity and imagination. Illusionists learn to bend light and sound, creating realistic illusions that can deceive even the most perceptive observers.
2014_subclasses.illusion.illusion-savant: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy an illusion spell into your spellbook is halved.
At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy an illusion spell into your spellbook is halved. (action).
2014_subclasses.illusion.improved-minor-: Also at 2nd level, you can change the nature of your illusions.
Also at 2nd level, you can change the nature of your illusions.
2014_subclasses.illusion.illusory-self.d: At 6th level, you can create an illusory duplicate of yourself.
2014_subclasses.illusion.illusory-self.s: At 10th level, when a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to create an illusory duplicate of yourself, causing the attack to miss you instead.
2014_subclasses.illusion.illusory-self-2: At 10th level, you can make an illusion real.
At 10th level, when a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to create an illusory duplicate of yourself, causing the attack to miss you instead.
2014_subclasses.illusion.illusory-realit: At 14th level, you can create an illusory creature.
At 14th level, you can create an illusory creature.
2014_subclasses.necromancy.description:
Necromancers study the forces of life and death. They can animate the dead, drain life force from living creatures, and even cheat death itself.

The study of necromancy requires a strong will and a willingness to confront the darker aspects of existence. Necromancers learn to harness the power of negative energy, using it to create undead servants and protect themselves from harm.
2014_subclasses.necromancy.savant.descri: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a necromancy spell into your spellbook is halved.
2014_subclasses.necromancy.savant.summar: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a necromancy spell into your spellbook is halved. (action).
Also at 2nd level, you can regain hit points when you kill a creature.
Also at 2nd level, you can regain hit points when you kill a creature.
2014_subclasses.necromancy.undead-thrall: At 6th level, you can animate undead.
At 6th level, when you raise a creature as an undead, it gains additional Hit Points and your proficiency bonus to its attacks and damage rolls. You can also command it as a bonus action.
2014_subclasses.necromancy.inured-to-und: At 10th level, you have resistance to necrotic damage.
At 10th level, you have resistance to necrotic damage.
2014_subclasses.necromancy.command-undea: At 14th level, you can command undead creatures.

At 14th level, you can use your action to target one undead creature within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 1 minute. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest.
2014_subclasses.scribes.description: The Order of Scribes is a tradition of wizards who believe that magic is a language. They study the written word and the arcane symbols that make up spells, and they use their knowledge to create new spells and modify existing ones.
2014_subclasses.scribes.wizardly-quill.d: At 2nd level, you can use a special quill to write spells into your spellbook. The quill doesn't require ink. When you use the quill to copy a spell into your spellbook, you can reduce the time and cost to copy the spell by half. You can also use the quill to create a spell scroll. When you do so, you must provide the spell's components, and the scroll costs half the normal amount of gold to create.
2014_subclasses.scribes.wizardly-quill.s: Can also use the quill to create a spell scroll. (action).
2014_subclasses.scribes.awakened-spellbo:
Starting at 2nd level, you have a spellbook that has been awakened by your magic. The spellbook has the following benefits:

You can use the spellbook as a spellcasting focus for your wizard spells.

When you cast a wizard spell with a spell slot, you can temporarily replace its damage type with the damage type of another spell in your spellbook of the same level. This replacement lasts for the duration of the spell.

When you cast a wizard spell as a ritual, you can use the spell's normal casting time, rather than adding 10 minutes to it. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

If your spellbook is lost, you can perform a special ritual to create a new one. This ritual takes 8 hours to complete, and you must have access to a wizard's spellbook to copy spells from. The new spellbook becomes your awakened spellbook.
This ritual takes 8 hours to complete, and you must have access to a wizard's spellbook to copy spells from. (action).
2014_subclasses.scribes.manifest-mind.de: Starting at 6th level, you can cause your spellbook to manifest a spectral mind. As a bonus action, you can cause the mind to appear in an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of you. The mind is a Tiny object, and it has AC 10, 1 hit point, and immunity to all damage except force damage. The mind is invisible, and it can't be targeted by attacks or spells. The mind lasts for 1 hour, until you dismiss it as a bonus action, or until you die. While the mind is present, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your wizard spells. In addition, you can cast spells as if you were in the mind's space, provided you can see the mind.
2014_subclasses.scribes.manifest-mind.su: Can cause the mind to appear in an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of you. (bonus action).
Starting at 10th level, you can create powerful scrolls. When you finish a long rest, you can create a number of spell scrolls equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). The scrolls must be for spells of 5th level or lower, and the spells must be in your spellbook. The scrolls cost half the normal amount of gold to create, and they last for 8 hours before becoming inert.
The scrolls cost half the normal amount of gold to create, and they last for 8 hours before becoming inert. (action).
2014_subclasses.scribes.one-with-words.d: At 14th level, your mastery of the written word allows you to cast spells without speaking. When you cast a wizard spell, you can cast it without verbal components. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
2014_subclasses.scribes.one-with-words.s: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest. (action).
2014_subclasses.transmutation.descriptio:
Transmuters manipulate the physical world. They can change the shape and properties of objects, transform one substance into another, and even alter their own bodies.

The study of transmutation requires a deep understanding of the natural world. Transmuters learn to reshape reality at a fundamental level, using their abilities to adapt to any situation and overcome any obstacle.
2014_subclasses.transmutation.savant.des: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a transmutation spell into your spellbook is halved.
2014_subclasses.transmutation.savant.sum: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a transmutation spell into your spellbook is halved. (action).
2014_subclasses.transmutation.minor-alch: Also at 2nd level, you can transmute materials.
At 2nd level, you can transmute one object into another material of the same size and value. The effect lasts for 1 hour or until the object takes any damage.
2014_subclasses.transmutation.transmuter: At 6th level, you can create a stone that grants benefits.
At 6th level, you can create a stone that grants benefits.
2014_subclasses.transmutation.shapechang: At 10th level, you can cast the polymorph spell on yourself.
At 10th level, you can cast the polymorph spell on yourself.
2014_subclasses.transmutation.master-tra: At 14th level, you can transmute matter at a touch.
At 14th level, you can transmute matter at a touch.
2014_subclasses.war-magic.description: The War Magic tradition is a school of wizardry that focuses on the practical application of magic in combat. War mages are skilled in both offensive and defensive magic, and they use their knowledge to survive on the battlefield.
2014_subclasses.war-magic.arcane-deflect: At 2nd level, you learn to weave your magic into a protective shield. When you are hit by an attack or you fail a saving throw against a spell or other magical effect, you can use your reaction to gain a +2 bonus to your AC against that attack or a +4 bonus to that saving throw. If you do so, you can't cast spells other than cantrips until the end of your next turn.
Can use your reaction to gain a +2 bonus to your AC against that attack or a +4 bonus to that saving throw. (reaction).
2014_subclasses.war-magic.tactical-wit.d: Starting at 2nd level, you add your Intelligence modifier to your initiative rolls.
2014_subclasses.war-magic.tactical-wit.s: Starting at 2nd level, you add your Intelligence modifier to your initiative rolls. (action).
2014_subclasses.war-magic.power-surge.de: Starting at 6th level, you can store magical energy inside your body to fuel your spells. You have a pool of power surges, represented by a number of d6s equal to your wizard level. When you make an attack roll or a saving throw, you can spend one power surge to add the roll of one d6 to the total. You can use this feature only once per turn. You regain all expended power surges when you finish a long rest.
2014_subclasses.war-magic.power-surge.su: Can spend one power surge to add the roll of one d6 to the total. (action).
At 10th level, the spells you cast help sustain your defenses. While you are maintaining concentration on a spell, you gain a +2 bonus to AC and to all saving throws.
At 10th level, while you are maintaining concentration on a spell, you gain a +2 bonus to AC and to all saving throws.
2014_subclasses.war-magic.deflecting-shr: At 14th level, your Arcane Deflection becomes more powerful. When you use your Arcane Deflection, you can choose up to three creatures within 10 feet of you. The bonus you gain from Arcane Deflection is granted to those creatures as well.
Can choose up to three creatures within 10 feet of you. (action).
